root_cause.text: The loop in `convert_chmap_v3()` uses `cs_desc->wLength` as the increment without first validating that it is at least the size of the cluster header descriptor, allowing a malformed descriptor with a too-small `wLength` to cause an infinite loop or out-of-bounds read.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (cs_len < sizeof(*cs_desc)) break;` and the commit message states "we forgot to validate cs_desc->wLength itself, which may lead to potential endless loop".

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a guard to break the loop when a control set descriptor length is less than the structure size, preventing potential out-of-bounds access from malformed descriptors.
intent_record.what: Adds a check that if `cs_len` (the length of a control set descriptor) is less than `sizeof(*cs_desc)`, the loop breaks. This is placed after computing `cs_len` and before the existing length check.
intent_record.how: At runtime, when processing descriptors, if a control set descriptor has a `wLength` field smaller than its structure size, the loop terminates early, preventing further processing that could read beyond valid data.
